findings.vulnerability_type: Transfer From msg.sender Instead of Contract
findings.title: Transfer is from msg.sender instead of contract balance
findings.description: In the function swapAndLiquify(), a call to the function transfer() is done to make a transfer from the contract address to the _buyBackAddress. But as the msg.sender for this transfer call will be the user doing the transaction, the amount will be deducted from that user’s account.
